ground_truth_requirement: annotations.json with info.review.status == REVIEWED, a named reviewer, and content that differs from every proposal file
category: person (any visible person, including partially visible and seated; exclude reflections, posters, mannequins)

detection.matching: COCO-style greedy by descending detector score
detection.small_gt_policy: ground-truth boxes shorter than min_gt_height_px are marked ignore: neither a miss nor a reason to call a matching prediction false
detection.ignore_regions: per-image polygons (image.ignore_regions); predictions whose foot point lies inside are not scored
detection.stage: pre-tracker detector output when available; post-tracker output is reported separately and labelled
detection.zero_denominators: precision undefined only when nothing was predicted; recall undefined only when no countable GT person exists; F1 = 2TP/(2TP+FP+FN), 0 when there are errors and no TP, undefined only when TP=FP=FN=0

tracking.identity: ground-truth track_id must stay constant for a person within one sequence
tracking.not_evaluated: a sequence that cannot be scored is reported NOT_EVALUATED with its reason, never as a score

also_record: latency (from the same run's analytics/extractor timings)
reporting.decision_rule: A detector replaces the provisional profile only if it beats it on recall at comparable precision on BOTH the detection set and the tracking sequences, with no regression > 0.05 in precision; ties keep the incumbent. Numerical-consistency checks and detection counts are not evidence of quality.

revised_at: 2026-10-27 (before any labels existed): per-image review status and zero-denominator rules made explicit
image_status_policy: Only images with annotation_status COMPLETE are scored. A COMPLETE image with no boxes is a reviewed negative frame: every detection on it is a false positive. UNREVIEWED/EXCLUDED images are reported as coverage and never treated as empty. A tracking sequence is scored only if all of its frames are COMPLETE and every reviewed person box has a track_id.
